qwen.primary: Geometric mean of paired process-mean resident rerank latency ratios across fixed interleaved blocks; every invocation contributes to its process mean. Absolute arithmetic means and all percentile definitions reported separately.
qwen.candidateAcceptance: Candidate versus teardown primary ratio <=0.98, one-sided 95% paired bootstrap upper ratio <1.0, and pooled nearest-rank p50/p95 no worse; all frozen oracles and equivalence checks pass.
qwen.parityCriterion: Candidate versus Dawn primary one-sided 95% upper ratio <=1.0 AND pooled nearest-rank p50 and p95 <= Dawn. No metric substitutions.
qwen.percentiles: bench/shared/lib/stats.js nearest rank sorted[ceil(n*p)-1]; conventional central-pair median is supplementary only; retain every sample and both bands.

umap.primary: Geometric mean of paired process-mean selected-operation latency ratios across independent alternating process pairs.
umap.acceptance: One-sided 95% paired bootstrap upper ratio <=1.05; otherwise regression or inconclusive, not equivalence. All original oracles and exact replay pass.
umap.order: Alternate teardown,candidate and candidate,teardown in successive pairs; unchanged controls bracket the cohort.
umap.counterpart: teardown-only build retains the accepted compute pool allowance and both memory-policy changes.

uncertainty.method: Deterministic percentile bootstrap over independent paired process log mean ratios; exp(mean(log ratios)); 95th percentile for one-sided upper confidence bound. Secondary raw arithmetic means and all per-process percentiles retained.

instrumentation: Temporary source counters only in isolated diagnostic builds; native interposer separate; all disabled in confirmation. UMAP retains its existing symmetric process-tree RSS observer.
rejection: Keep teardown correctness repair and retained pool policy if targeted candidate fails. No added waits to increase cache hits. No second optimization.
